decisions.title: Adopt Blueprint and build icon catalogue
decisions.quote: First I want to convert this into a Utkal Blueprint project and a build icon list for our icon that we can use
decisions.scope: Local Blueprint conversion and reusable icon list. Design acceptance and publication remain separate.

decisions.title: Literary benchmark and theme-grounded icon design
decisions.quote: Study the most popular poetry and literary sites and see if we can learn from them.
decisions.scope: Research reference sites and prepare Odisha-linked, earthy, poetic icon candidates per the same user message.

decisions.title: Option A single-colour icon treatment
decisions.scope: Single-colour Quiet ink treatment selected. Specific motif placement remains under review; earth accents are not the selected direction.
decisions.quote: I like the icon with the single-color option A

decisions.title: Show the editors with their defined roles
decisions.quote: Add the editors with their defined roles to the website.
decisions.scope: Make the publication editors and their sourced titles visible in the local site; link their profiles. No invented duties, appointments or reporting structure.

decisions.title: Complete Blueprint persona setup
decisions.quote: Let's go ahead and implement UB?
decisions.scope: Four pinned Blueprint personas adapted to KBL and assigned for on-demand work in the current chat; current permissions only.

decisions.title: Move all non-site work into the KB
decisions.quote: All the things that we have done that are not part of the site should move to KB
decisions.scope: Supporting files, historical assets and local review material become KB-owned; preserve working site and portable handoff.

decisions.title: Self-contained replacement website and Git/analytics preparation
decisions.quote: This is a new redesign and a complete, self-sufficient site - we should not link anything to the old site. This will replace the old site.
decisions.scope: Remove reader-facing legacy dependencies; prepare local Git and analytics under the same user request. Full content import remains required; no deployment is implied.

decisions.title: Private feedback, social sharing and Utkal-aligned Firebase approach
decisions.quote: Social sharing and private feedback; no public comments for launch (recommended)
decisions.scope: Apply selected engagement model. Review Utkal Project and follow its static-public/private-Firebase approach; no GA4 ID exists yet.

decisions.title: GitHub project storage and GitHub Pages hosting
decisions.quote: We will store everything in GitHub, and the website will be a git site
decisions.scope: Follow Utkal Project stack; GitHub owns source, KB and historical assets, Pages serves the static build, Firebase holds private runtime feedback.

decisions.title: Create private repository and free Firebase project
decisions.quote: Approve repository creation and Firebase terms
decisions.scope: Private ahimanikya/kabita-live repository and Firebase terms acceptance; Mumbai Firestore and IST Analytics approved separately. No paid plan, repository publicity or site publication authorized.

decisions.title: Make Kabita Live repository public for GitHub Pages
decisions.quote: We can make kabita-live public since we host website and link to domain
decisions.scope: Make ahimanikya/kabita-live public including website source, KB and preserved history; configure Pages. Content readiness and release authorization still govern publication and domain cutover.

decisions.title: Capture and enrich all contributor profiles
decisions.quote: 427 writer can have their own page, and we should use a skill- maybe as we did for the editor- to give an artistic profile picture and research each of them to profile a better narrative about them. Also link their contribution to Kabita Live
decisions.scope: Browser capture, local writer pages and contribution links, identity-grounded research and faithful artistic portraits. Latest direction: Maybe use browser skill to capture them? No website publication authorized.

decisions.title: Extract and link complete editions and poems
decisions.quote: Now let's extract all editions and poems for each one of them and link them up. Keep the content organized by edition
decisions.scope: Capture all observed edition and poem content, preserve sources, organize local content by edition, and connect readers and writer contributions. No website publication.

decisions.title: Apply editor-style author pages and reusable skills
decisions.quote: Now, I want to fix the author's page as we did for 2 editors - let's make the author's page something similar. Build skills and use them to build
decisions.scope: Reuse approved editor components across local author pages; build and install project skills; create and integrate featured portrait examples and sourced narrative enhancements. No publication.

decisions.title: Quiet table for author contributions
decisions.quote: Let's go with A
decisions.scope: Apply the Option A quiet table to author/editor contribution sections, record in design system and synchronize handoff. Local implementation; no publication.

decisions.title: Clear story author pages with visible external book links
decisions.quote: I like A. Remove Sources and portrait credit, All writers, Explore the editions, and Read the poems. Restore external link the way it was.
decisions.scope: Apply Clear story to author pages with requested link removals and visible book links; retain source credits in Our Story. Local only.

decisions.title: Each author opens with a quote from their own poetry
decisions.quote: On the poet page — instead of repeating ମାଟିର ମହକ · ମନର ସ୍ୱର extract one quote from their poems that is quote worthy.
decisions.scope: Replace the author-page signature with one source-exact excerpt and local poem citation. Preserve original language. Local implementation only.

decisions.title: Earth & voice quotes and count-aware collection headings
decisions.quote: I like C. Can we make the count merge with the heading — make a dynamic statement based on the count.
decisions.scope: Apply quote option C to author profiles and incorporate actual poem counts into the shared collection heading. Local only.

decisions.title: Homepage export and icon-only narrow-screen menu
decisions.quote: The JSON file my decisions recorded. Also I wanted to use an icon instead of calling it Menu in the header.
decisions.scope: Apply the seven explicitly approved homepage choices from the supplied export and the shared icon menu. Excerpt and portrait-card revisions remain candidates. Local only.

decisions.title: Homepage poem cards A: small round portraits and aligned excerpts
decisions.quote: I selected Option A
decisions.scope: Apply revised home-card-review Option A to homepage, including portrait-left identity, laterite labels, aligned excerpts with ellipsis and removal of duplicate poet strip. Local only.

decisions.title: Create Kabita Live Facebook and Instagram profiles
decisions.quote:
Use browser skill to create a Facebook page and an Instagram page for Kabita Live

We will then link them to the website and create a schedule to post something new every day to drive engagement.
decisions.scope: Create the two brand profiles using Browser. Website linking and daily posting are subsequent work; required authentication and account terms remain user steps.

decisions.title: Shared site appearance: System, Light and Dark; homepage fine art edge
decisions.quote: Approved both, except I want to make the dark theme icon clickable - instead of a dropdown. Subsequent refinement: toggle should have a system mode too Subsequent scope: This is for the entire site and it should remember my selection
decisions.scope: Shared direct System/Light/Dark icon and persisted selection across all reader pages. Header is the only theme control; the duplicate poem-toolbar button is removed. Homepage warm art edge retained. Local only.

decisions.title: Complete Kabita Live Facebook presentation; defer website linking
decisions.quote:
Website linking we will do this after migration

For now, update the cover photo, add editor info, and add some images and other information to make the page look complete and inviting.
decisions.scope: Facebook cover, editor information, images and welcoming posts. Website linking deferred until migration.

decisions.title: Edition pages: cover narrative and simple multilingual contents
decisions.quote: Remove the footer navigation of the edition or make it simple and subtle. Replace signature and poem count with cover image story. Remove edition search, Reading language label and result count. Use icon with hover text instead of arrow; language in its own column.
decisions.scope: All 47 edition pages; local implementation only.

decisions.title: Replace Facebook cover with improved original illustration
decisions.quote: Can we use better cover image - create one if required
decisions.scope: Generate and use a better Kabita Live Facebook cover; preserve earlier art and deferred website linking.

decisions.title: Single-line Odia signature on Facebook cover
decisions.quote: The odia line can be one line
decisions.scope: Facebook cover signature on one line; retain existing brand and artwork.

decisions.title: Link Kabita Live Facebook Page from website footer
decisions.quote: Now link the FB page to Home Pahe, add to the footer menu list
decisions.scope: Add Facebook to shared website footer menu, including Home. Local site update; no deployment.

decisions.title: Poem reader A with opening actions, captions and quiet navigation
decisions.quote: Approbed A with comments; Option A is better
decisions.scope: Apply illustrated reader A to all 801 poems, incorporating review notes. Local implementation only.

decisions.title: Curved icon-only poem navigation: option B
decisions.quote: b
decisions.scope: Use approved curved arrows across poem pages with 48px targets, tooltips and disabled boundary controls. Local implementation only.

decisions.title: Poem byline portraits and a separate poem artwork collection
decisions.quote: B is good. Poem images are not going to reuse cover image.
decisions.scope: Small profile portrait beside poem byline; varied poem-only illustrations, with edition covers excluded. Local implementation.

decisions.title: Audit artwork, name edition covers and connect poem illustrations to text
decisions.quote: Audit all our images and organize them based on how we plan to use them. Name the cover image based on the edition. Connect the image with poem somehow.
decisions.scope: Local asset organization, contextual image matching, poem opening alignment and continuous header separator tone. Preserve all originals and exclude covers from poems.

decisions.title: Discoverable imagery knowledge and one canonical caption per artwork
decisions.quote: Update the OKF for the imagery knowledge base for easier finding next time. For consistency, the same image should not have a different caption in different locations.
decisions.scope: Canonical image identity and captions, searchable imagery records and shared caption rendering. Border recommendation retains current treatments; no blanket border change or publication.

decisions.title: Approve translations, refine underlining and audition natural recitation
decisions.quote: Approved language translation. Underline: Can we do a partial line. No—prepare an audition plan first.
decisions.scope: Approve one-poem language-translation feature; add partial text underlining; reject initial digital voice delivery; prepare audition plan without account setup or paid generation.

decisions.title: Prepare fuller website design walkthrough for editors
decisions.quote:
Create a design proposal document and give them heads up whats coming
Preference: Fuller walkthrough of the design and reading features
decisions.scope: Create shareable proposal and accompanying message. No external messaging or website launch.

decisions.title: Remove holds based only on missing original-language sources
decisions.quote: we dont need source info dont put them in hold
decisions.scope: Use existing published poem text without requiring underlying originals or source information. Release ten source-only holds; retain four actual content corrections. Preserve existing credits and historical evidence.

decisions.title: Repair recoverable poem content and archive unresolved entries
decisions.quote: see if you can fix, else we will remove them from edition and keep in archive
decisions.scope: Separate two clearly attributed appended works; retain original text and evidence. Remove unavailable records385 and727 from active editions, preserve archival entries and existing URLs. No publication.

decisions.title: Push current project and host a GitHub Pages preview before DNS migration
decisions.quote: All done then - now we need to push this to git and get it hosted and then will ask het to channge DNA
decisions.scope: Commit and push the current project to the existing public repository; manually deploy the public-only Astro build to GitHub Pages for pre-DNS review. DNS and custom domain remain unchanged.

decisions.title: Deploy completed poet portraits and editor refinements now
decisions.quote: Good deploy this - also deploy all poet portrait that are done
decisions.scope: Immediate checkpoint deployment of all currently completed and verified poet portraits plus the approved Pradeep, Paresh and Pravakar refinements. Supersedes final-only restriction for this checkpoint; pending portraits and holds excluded. Existing manual Pages preview workflow, DNS and service settings retained; generation loop continues.

decisions.title: Selectively refine and publish thirteen reviewed watercolor portraits
decisions.quote: OK, let's go with your reco and fix them, push to git and update the web site too
decisions.scope: Regenerate and source-review the thirteen retrospective shortlist candidates, retain only improvements, preserve originals and prior versions, commit and push scoped changes and deploy through the existing manual public-only Pages preview workflow. Nine source-review cases and existing holds excluded. No full-library regeneration, DNS or runtime-service changes. Temporary portrait-schedule hold prevents overlapping generation; restore afterward.

decisions.title: Activate Firebase and add Likes and public comments
decisions.quote: Can we activate firebase? And add like button? and add public comment?
decisions.scope: Prepare and activate private feedback, reversible Likes and public comments on Kabita Live. Supersedes earlier no-public-comments scope. Moderation defaults to editor approval while optional preference is pending. Broader CLI OAuth access still requires explicit approval. No billing or DNS changes.

decisions.title: Edition-specific imagery pilot in an autonomous batch loop
decisions.quote: Sounds good, let’s do that. Do that in batched and keep a loop
decisions.scope: Three-edition local pilot: 45,46,47; nine new interior artworks in three sequential edition batches; eight explicit text-led poem openings. Covers, poems, existing bespoke art and other editions preserved. No publication. No per-image or per-batch approval gate. Stop after the bounded pilot.

decisions.title: Publish the approved pilot and extend edition-specific artwork to every edition
decisions.quote: This is excellent - let’s push this and make this happen for all the editions
decisions.scope: Publish the approved9-artwork/8text-led pilot, then extend the same poem-informed interior art strategy to all47editions in the existing autonomous loop. Preserve covers, poems, existing bespoke art and unrelated changes. Continue autonomous edition batches without per-image approval, with verified publication checkpoints. Supersedes pilot-only and no-publication limits for this artwork scope.

decisions.title: Apply the three approved poem closing marks to pages and the quiet reader
decisions.quote: This is nice, let's apply
decisions.scope: Apply single leaf, paired leaf and fine sprig after final verse, one stable choice per poem across languages and quiet-reader views. Preserve wording, page navigation and passage offsets. Local application; no new deployment scope.

decisions.title: Refine poem-ending spacing, neighbouring navigation and footer emphasis
decisions.quote: ok
decisions.scope: Tighten the ending spacing; navigation within poem reading width with neighbouring titles; smaller lighter closing mark; quieter ownership/footer text. Preserve paper and boat artwork. Local application only.

decisions.title: Publish the approved poem closing marks and ending refinement
decisions.quote: apply
decisions.scope: Publish only approved closing marks and ending refinement using the established manual public-only Pages preview workflow. Preserve current portraits, artwork, poem text, consent, runtime, noindex and DNS.
